posts.title: Teaching, Learning, and Community in Psychology
posts.description: I’m thrilled to share the Spring 2026 issue of “Beyond the Blackboard,” the newsletter of the Canadian Psychological Association’s Teaching of Psychology (ToP) Section. posts.title: Innovation and progress for the future of higher education: An introduction to the latest issue (15.1) of CJSoTL
posts.description: 🎉 The new issue (15.1) of The Canadian Journal for the Scholarship of Teaching and Learning (CJSoTL) is now available online! Read it all here: https://shorturl.at/jQ4tv. For an overview of the key themes covered, check out my introduction for the issue: https://shorturl.at/vZEqa.

posts.title: Investigating Teaching & Learning during the COVID-19 Pandemic
